projectTitle: Occlude (opaque references to sensitive values for Java)
description: Occlude (org.jwcarman.occlude) keeps sensitive values in custody and hands out occluded references labelled on application-defined axes; revealing a value is the one checked operation, decided against the destination's ceiling. Built on the lattice and object-capability models, with JDBC storage and Spring Boot support.
rules: Declare sources and reveals on a charter and pass the returned objects to the code that needs them: Occlude has no registry to look authority up from.
Pass Occluded<T> references around and reveal only at a declared reveal point, never by converting the value to a String early.
For Spring Boot add occlude-spring-boot-starter and a PostgreSQL JDBC driver.
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/occlude/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the Occlude version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
